note: Natrona County campground on a point in Pathfinder Reservoir, off County Road 409 (Pathfinder Road) and Bishop Road. Sheltered and unsheltered sites, restrooms, and high- and low-water boat ramps that reach the reservoir at any level. Water levels swing widely: sites can be at the water's edge one year and 1,500 ft from it another. The wildlife preserve area is day use only. --Claude
